scene artpicture
Let me tell you a story.
A long time ago, before either one of us existed, there was a seed.
There was also a light.
The light nourished the seed. Then it grew into some other thing and another thing showed up and then more stuff happened and here we are.
It’s all very difficult to follow.
But the important thing to take away from all of it is that there was a very specific order events needed to occur in for us to make it to where we are today.
But what if that light had never appeared?
What if that seed was never nourished?
We’re fragile things, you and me.
I may not look the part, but I am no more or less mortal than you.
If you pinch me, I will scream. And if you cut my belly open, the same stream of colors would pour from my body as yours if I were to return the favor and open you the same way.
All it takes for us to disappear is one little mistake.
And it’s scary enough going outside knowing that this mistake does not even have to rest in your hands...and that your life could be cut short by someone else tripping over their own eight feet.
How terribly unfair is that?
Why would anyone ever go outside in the first place knowing everything they think and feel could come crashing down at any moment?
It all gets more complicated when you realize that simply isolating yourself won’t help either.
Time moves in both ways.
There are things happening in every direction, and every single one of them could impact where you’ll be tomorrow and who you’ll see the next time you open your eyes.
Which is why we should cherish the dark.
For if there is no light, and there is no seed — there would have never been a you or me.
Our fragile timeline would snap like an old bridge and everyone we know, currently trapped between the wooden stakes holding it up labeled past and future, would plummet to their deaths.
But that’s just a metaphor.
It would be more like never existing in the first place.
We’d feel no pain as we’d have never developed the ability to feel it.
There would be no lingering regret of a future unexplored because we’d never be ordained to explore it at all.
We’d just be energy, or a lack thereof — waiting for whatever we’re supposed to cite as the creator to just press the start button so we can begin our long and painful journey.
In a sense...
That makes you a bit of a god too, doesn’t it?
What if we’re all gods? Packed to the gills with divine blood and celestial plasma- all simultaneously pressing “Start” but spawning in different locations at different stages in life.
These are questions I can only pose as the dark was killed by what came after.
But when I go to sleep at night, I dream of a world where it wasn’t.
And those dreams are so peaceful-
Because it’s more like they’re not even happening.
scene black
Sometimes, it feels like there’s a little too much truth floating around.
So much, in fact, that if you were to spend the entirety of your life doing nothing but collecting information, you’d still know nothing at all when your time here has come and gone.
It’s no different for those of us who can never expire.
I, too, often feel that it’s all so overwhelming.
Yet I remain here amidst the Nothing as it is my job to think.
It goes deeper than you know.
For every question answered, there will be ten more asked.
With that in mind, would it not be better to wish that we were all just gone?
Only in the light will you be given a mission.
And only in the dark will it be fulfilled.
It’s such a shame that these two cannot co-exist.
Tell me-
And I only ask this because I’ve been wondering for quite some time-

scene onlyamimattersandeveryoneelseisdumb1
: What the fuck are you smiling about?! I’m trying to have a serious conversation with you!
: I’m obviously smiling because it looks like you two are still my friends after all! Yay!
: But you might want to keep it juuuuuuuuust a little bit quieter or you’ll wake Sensei up. And he needs his sleep or he’ll be grumpy all day.
: I’m already awake, Ami.
scene onlyamimattersandeveryoneelseisdumb2

: Oh, good morning. I just made some coffee with our brand new 10-cup Chemex Vase that you can help yourself to. Sorry Maya’s such a loud-mouth and wound up waking you up. I tried to get her to be quiet.
scene onlyamimattersandeveryoneelseisdumb3
Ayane quickly retreats to my side as soon as I-
: Ayane, what do you think you’re-
: Ami! Talk to me! I’m the one who’s pissed off at you right now, not Ayane!
scene onlyamimattersandeveryoneelseisdumb4
: Sorry, did you say you’re pissed off at me? Shouldn’t it be the other way around?
: After you called us out in the middle of the night and ditched us? No. It probably shouldn’t. And I think it’s pretty fucking normal that we’re mad at you about that.
scene onlyamimattersandeveryoneelseisdumb5
: I ditched you?! Are you kidding?! You guys called me and told me to meet you in the Old District! Even after I said I didn’t want to!
: We...what? No, that’s-
: Do you have any idea how lost I was?! It’s a miracle Sensei was able to find me!
scene onlyamimattersandeveryoneelseisdumb6
: Bullshit! You’re the one who called me and told me to meet you at the shrine!
: Why would I ever ask to meet you at the shrine? That’s stupid. If you’re going to come up with a lie, at least make it a believable one.
: It’s more believable than me asking you to meet me in the Old District when you know I can’t even go there!
: Why not?
: Why not what?
: Why can’t you go there, Maya? I don’t think you’ve ever told me before.
scene onlyamimattersandeveryoneelseisdumb7
: I’m a good friend, so I never bothered prying. But if you’re going to use that as an excuse, you should at least tell me why, right?
: Because if you don’t, it’s just going to sound like you’re making things up. And you’d never do that, right?
scene onlyamimattersandeveryoneelseisdumb8
: Oh! I know! How about we make it into a little game! I’ll confess one thing, and then you can confess another! It’ll be a good way for us to show each other we still value our friendship!
: You start! Why can’t you go to the Old District?
: What do you think you’re doing?
: Fine! I’ll start!
scene onlyamimattersandeveryoneelseisdumb9
: Sometimes, I try on your clothes while you’re not around and pretend to be you! And I’m happy to say that my Maya impression is actually getting really good!
: Your turn!
scene onlyamimattersandeveryoneelseisdumb10
: Ayane, is everything-
: Mhm. All good. Just...a little headache. That’s all.
: Are you sure that’s-
scene onlyamimattersandeveryoneelseisdumb11
: Mhm! Totally sure! Nothing to worry about here! Just...getting my daily dose of Sensei!
: Ayane, I’m really going to need you to-
scene onlyamimattersandeveryoneelseisdumb12
: Ami! Come on!
: Jeez, you’re really bad at this game.
: It’s not a game! And I have no idea what you’re trying to pull here by pretending we’re the ones who ditched you, but it’s two against one here and you’re not fooling anybody!
scene onlyamimattersandeveryoneelseisdumb13
: It’s always two against one lately! And I don’t know what it is that compelled you guys to stop treating me like a friend, but it’s not fair! I didn’t do anything to you! Ever!
: If you wanna weed me out, that’s one thing! But if you think I’m gonna let you bully me and pick on me by...leading me on and stuff, then you can get the heck out of my house!
: Bully you?...What the fuck are you talking about? We haven’t done anything like that.
scene onlyamimattersandeveryoneelseisdumb14
: Liar! Liar! Liar! Liar! Liar! Liar! Liar! Liar!

: You guys are picking on me because you don’t like how close I am to Sensei and you’re trying to take him away! But I won’t let you! He’s mine and he sees everything I do! He’ll be on my side no matter what!
scene onlyamimattersandeveryoneelseisdumb15
: Right, Sensei?!
: Nh!
: Ami, I get that you’re upset, but can you stop yelling? I’m pretty sure you’re scaring Ayane.
scene onlyamimattersandeveryoneelseisdumb16

: Scaring her? I don’t think that’s true. She’s probably just being manipulated by Maya into thinking I’m the bad guy when I’m not even that mad at her. Maya’s the one who called me last night after all.
: So if Ayane wants to apologize for ditching me, I’ll forgive her right now since I’m such a good person!
: Ayaneeeeeeeee?
scene onlyamimattersandeveryoneelseisdumb17
: H...Heeeeey Ami...Good morning...
: Wow, you really do look scared. How come? Don’t you, like...know karate and stuff? Shouldn't I be the one afraid of you?
: I’m not afraid! I just...you know me! Always wanting to be close to Sensei and...that’s what I’m doing now.
: Is that really all you're doing?
scene onlyamimattersandeveryoneelseisdumb18
: Leave Ayane out of this! I’m the one yelling at you, not her!
: Nobody should be yelling at me since I’m a good girl who never does anything wrong.
: All I wanted was to be friends with you and live happily ever after, but now you’re trying to force me out. You can’t blame me for being a little upset about that, can you?
: For the last time, no one is trying to force you out!
: Then how come you guys are always hanging out with Sensei without me? He’s my uncle, you know. It’s really weird if other teenagers are just spending their free time hanging out with him.
: Ami, it’s up to me how I spend my time. Don’t take my decisions out on them.
scene onlyamimattersandeveryoneelseisdumb19
: So you’re the one deciding to hang out with my friends without me? It’s not just them trying to steal you?
: If I say yes, will you leave them alone?
: You say that like I’m tormenting them. They’re the ones who showed up here. I was just trying to be a good niece and make breakfast like I always do.
: If I really wanted to torment them, I wouldn’t wait for them to find me, would I?
: Ami-
: When have I ever gone out of my way to do anything mean to Ayane or Maya? I just want them to love me as much as I love them.
: Then just...put all of this behind you for now.
scene onlyamimattersandeveryoneelseisdumb20
: You’re...gonna forgive them for leading me to the middle of nowhere that easily? Really?
: We didn’t do-
: Maya, let me handle this.
: I don’t care who called who or...who ditched who, but something like that is too small to kill a friendship over when you’ve all known each other for years.
: So just put it behind you for now and...try to move on. And know that Maya and Ayane probably wouldn’t have shown up here if they didn’t care about you. They came here because they cared.
scene onlyamimattersandeveryoneelseisdumb21
: Mm...I guess I didn’t really think of it like that...
: I just don’t want us growing apart and it really feels like they don’t want me as a part of the group sometimes...
: I don’t mind apologizing and trying to move on, but...it’d be nice to hear them say they love me at least.
: If they can do that...I can probably convince myself they don’t mean any harm.
: I do love you, Ami. And I hope this really was just...some miraculous misunderstanding, but-
: I love you too, Maya...I’m sorry for getting mad.
: Don’t...
: Don’t...worry about it?...
scene onlyamimattersandeveryoneelseisdumb22
: Ayane? Do you-
scene onlyamimattersandeveryoneelseisdumb23
: ...Ayane?
: Mhm. I love you, Ami. A lot.
: You don’t really look like-
: Just leave it for now, Ami. We all love you.
scene onlyamimattersandeveryoneelseisdumb24
: Okay...
: If you say so, Sensei.
: But I’ll be keeping a close eye on everybody to make sure of that, okay?
scene black
I actually manage to deescalate a situation for once and send Maya and Ayane on their way.
And while I can’t help but feel like I should set up some kind of meeting with them to talk about this in the future, I realize that’s exactly what Ami has a problem with in the first place.
They might not be trying to “steal me” from her or anything like that, but I can only imagine how it must feel to watch everyone you love have fun without you.
Maybe this whole...Ami-reset situation could use a bit of a reevaluation on Maya’s end...Especially since she still hasn’t made it apparent what the big deal is when it comes to including her.
If we could actually involve Ami in some way...that might work wonders in getting her to go back to her normal, cheerful self.
I love my niece. She’s one of the most amazing aspects of my life.
But even I know when enough is enough.
And she’s slowly turning into something that will be much harder to love.
scene onlyamimattersandeveryoneelseisdumb25
: So...I guess I should be getting back to breakfast now, huh?
: Ami...I think we need to have a little talk.
if amifingered == False:
: If it’s about me sleeping in your bed last night, I’m not going to apologize.
: I get that you don’t want to have sex with me for whatever stupid reason you came up with, but I didn’t lay a finger on you. Which is very impressive given just how much I wanted to.
else:
: Don’t worry, I’m not pregnant. I already checked.
: What? No.
: It’s not that. I just...
: I think you need to give me a little more space.
: Sure.
: I get that you’re dependent on me and everything, but-
: Okay.
: No, listen. I get that you’ve essentially centered your entire life around me and that...me not going along with that makes you feel insignificant-
: Whatever you want.
: But that’s not what I’m trying to do. I just need to be able to exist on my own now that I’m finally learning to...function as an adult and-
: You can have space.
: Can you at least let me finish before you completely reject- Wait, what?
: I said you can have space. I get it.
: I’m too clingy. And I’ll try and be less clingy for your sake since that’s what you want from me.
: Can I feel your forehead?
scene onlyamimattersandeveryoneelseisdumb26
: Sensei, I’m not sick. I get it.
: Do whatever you want. I know you love me enough to not make any...stupid mistakes that will hurt me or anything.
: Plus, spending a little less time thinking about you will give me a chance to focus on other stuff for a little while.
: Ami, please let me feel your forehead.
scene onlyamimattersandeveryoneelseisdumb27
: I know it’s probably not my place to ask for anything here since...this is all kind of the result of me just being a little too attached in the first place, but...
: Would you mind if I asked for a teensy little favor in exchange for more of this “space” that you want all of a sudden?
: How “teensy” are we talking here?
scene onlyamimattersandeveryoneelseisdumb28
: Really teensy.
: Then...what is it?
